course.about: 9 AM and 7:30 PM reels teach pipeline/syllabus.json in order. 'next' = the next lesson to start; 'pending_parts' = planned remaining parts of the current lesson (do these first, in order).

pending_parts.title: What a domain is and why we need it
pending_parts.focus: Map Q1+Q2. A domain = the technical attributes of a field (data type, length, decimals, output) defined ONCE. Problem without it: every field repeats type/length; change one, miss ten. Recap: Part 1 showed the Definition tab and ALPHA. Accurate analogy: domain = template/technical shape.

pending_parts.title: Where a domain is used
pending_parts.focus: Map Q3. Chain: domain -> data element -> table field / structure component / program variable (TYPE data element). One domain, many data elements. Show SE11 Where-Used List (button in the SE11 toolbar) on a domain.

pending_parts.title: Create a domain step by step
pending_parts.focus: Map Q4. SE11 -> radio button Domain -> Z/Y name -> Create -> Short Description -> Definition tab (type + length) -> Save -> package + transport request (or Local Object $TMP) -> Check -> Activate (Ctrl+F3). Show every click.

pending_parts.title: Definition tab: the Format block
pending_parts.focus: Map Q5. Data Type (built-in DDIC types: CHAR, NUMC, DEC, INT4, DATS, TIMS, CURR, QUAN — what each stores, CHAR vs NUMC), No. Characters, Decimal Places. Real example values.

pending_parts.title: Definition tab: Output Characteristics
pending_parts.focus: Map Q5. Output Length, Convers. Routine (ALPHA: zeros in on input, out on output; other routines exist), Sign (negative values allowed), Lower Case (otherwise input is converted to upper case).

pending_parts.title: Value Range tab: single values (fixed values)
pending_parts.focus: Map Q6. Fixed values + short descriptions: become the F4 list and an automatic input check on screens; NOT checked in your own SELECT/UPDATE. Example values. Why they exist.

pending_parts.title: Value Range tab: intervals
pending_parts.focus: Map Q6. Intervals with Lower Limit / Upper Limit; combine with single values; checked on screen input like fixed values.

pending_parts.title: Value table: why it exists
pending_parts.focus: Map Q6. Value Table field on the Value Range tab: it is only the PROPOSED check table when you create a foreign key on a field using this domain; it does not check anything by itself. Example: domain LAND1 -> value table T005. Value table vs check table.

pending_parts.title: Domain key points
pending_parts.focus: Map Q7. One domain serves many data elements; changing a domain changes every field using it (length change on tables with data -> adjust with SE14); fixed values check only on screens; domains are not used directly in programs (use the data element).

pending_parts.title: Domain mistakes + interview questions
pending_parts.focus: Map Q8+Q9 (+ recap quiz Q10 as quiz end card). Mistakes: SELECT with unconverted ALPHA value, expecting fixed values to block a program UPDATE, confusing value table with check table. Interview: domain vs data element, fixed values vs value table vs check table, can one domain be used by several data elements.
